rationale: Image-less, centered, compact banner: H2, paragraph and two centered buttons.

contentPattern.description: Visual-tree hint is block; a centered call-to-action banner (headline, text, CTAs) uses the Hero content model without an image. Orange comes from the section style, not the block.
contentPattern.structure: one cell: H2 heading, paragraph, CTA links (one link per paragraph); background color comes from the section style (e.g. Section Metadata style: orange, centered)

cells: Eyebrow paragraph, heading, subheading, CTA links

usage: Use as a closing or mid-page call to action. Put it in its own section and set the color through section metadata.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any centered headline-text-buttons banner without an image. For a photo background use hero-fullbleed.
